title: A Heterogeneous Mixture of Experts Framework for Interpretable Machine Learning
abstract: arXiv:2608.24195v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models provide a flexible framework for partitioning complex prediction problems into simpler local learning tasks through an input-dependent gating mechanism. Existing interpretable MoE approaches, such as Mixture of Decision Trees (MoDT), achieve transparency by employing homogeneous decision-tree experts, but this restricts the model to a single inductive bias across all regions of the feature space. We extend the MoDT framework by introducing heterogeneous expert families comprising decision trees, linear support vector machines, and quadratic discriminant analysis under a common probabilistic gating mechanism. To ensure coherent likelihood-based inference, non-probabilistic experts are calibrated to produce conditional class probabilities, allowing parameter estimation within the generalized Expectation-Maximization framework of MoDT. translated_title: 一种用于可解释机器学习的异构专家混合框架
translated_abstract: 专家混合（MoE）模型通过输入依赖的门控机制，为将复杂预测问题分解为更简单的局部学习任务提供了灵活框架。现有的可解释MoE方法，如决策树混合（MoDT），通过采用同质决策树专家实现透明性，但这将模型限制为在特征空间的所有区域使用单一归纳偏置。我们通过引入异构专家家族扩展了MoDT框架，该家族包括决策树、线性支持向量机和二次判别分析，并在统一的概率门控机制下运行。为确保基于似然的连贯推理，非概率专家被校准以生成条件类别概率，从而允许在MoDT的广义期望最大化框架内进行参数估计。我们进一步为所提出的方法建立了理论上的单调上升保证。
tldr: 本文提出了一种异构专家混合框架，结合决策树、线性SVM和二次判别分析专家，通过概率门控和校准机制提升可解释机器学习模型的灵活性与理论保障。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a heterogeneous mixture-of-experts framework combining decision trees, linear SVMs, and quadratic discriminant analysis, with probabilistic calibration and monotone ascent guarantees for enhanced interpretable machine learning.
